expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.mode==='emissio' && S.ny===3 && S.na===2 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: emission, n_y = 3, n_a = 2 (must run before any setup)
on load: ΔE = 1,89 eV (lesson-answers koe1-dE-3)
on load: λ = 656 nm (lesson-answers koe1-lam-3)

expr: (() => { const L=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select')].map(s=>[...s.options].map(o=>o.value).join(',')); return L.length===4 && L[0]==='emissio,absorptio' && L[1]==='2,3,4,5,6' && L[2]==='1,2,3,4' && L[3]==='0.5,1,2' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: four selects: mode, upper level 2–6, lower level 1–4, speed hidas/normaali/nopea
DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words
adapter declares tila, ny and na

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); const w=document.getElementById('sim-root').clientWidth; return c.width===600 && c.height===(w<500?860:400) ? 1 : 0; })()
note: canvas 600x400 on a wide screen, 600x860 (stacked, larger labels) under 500 px
the readout shows ΔE in eV and λ in nm
